dbscan =: 4 : 0
    neighborhoods =. x

    labels =. (#neighborhoods)$_2
    cluster =. 0
    for_point. i.#neighborhoods do.
        if. _2~:point{labels do.
            continue.
        end.
        if. -.point{core do.
            labels =. _1 point}labels
            continue.
        end.
        labels =. cluster point}labels
        queue =. point{::neighborhoods
        head =. 0
        while. head<#queue do.
            other =. head{queue
            head =. head+1
            if. _1=other{labels do.
                labels =. cluster other}labels
            elseif. _2=other{labels do.
                labels =. cluster other}labels
                if. other{core do.
                    queue =. queue,other{::neighborhoods
                end.
            end.
        end.
        cluster =. cluster+1
    end.
    (<labels),<core
)

    points =. x

            for_gx. (column-1)+i.3 do.
                cell_index =. cells i.<gx,gy
                if. cell_index<#cells do.
                    for_other. cell_index{::members do.
                        candidates =. candidates+1

                        end.
                    end.

            end.

        neighborhoods =. neighborhoods,<neighbors

    sizes =. #&>members
    coordinates =. >cells

    (<cells),(<members),(<neighborhoods),(<candidates),<busiest
)

compute_xi =: 3 : 0
    XiAlpha =: *:XiV-XiU
    XiBeta =: *:XiV
    steep_up =. steep_down =. up =. down =. i.0
    for_i. i.N do.
        first =. i{Positions
        second =. (i+1){Positions
        defined =. (first~:INF)+.second~:INF
        steep_up =. steep_up,defined*.first xle second
        steep_down =. steep_down,defined*.second xle first
        up =. up,first<second
        down =. down,first>second
    end.
    areas =. 0$a:
    clusters =. 0 2$0
    down_areas =. 0 3$0
    index =. 0
    mib =. 0
    for_start. i.N do.
        if. (start<index)+.-.((start{steep_up)+.start{steep_down) do.
            continue.
        end.
        mib =. mib>.>./((index+i.1+start-index){Positions)
        if. mib=INF do.
            down_areas =. 0 3$0
        else.
            retained =. 0 3$0
            for_area. down_areas do.
                if. mib xle ({.area){Positions do.
                    area =. ((2{area)>.mib)2}area
                    retained =. retained,area
                end.
            end.
            down_areas =. retained
        end.
        if. start{steep_down do.
            finish =. region_end (<start),(<steep_down),<up
            areas =. areas,< 'down';start;finish
            down_areas =. down_areas,start,finish,0
            index =. finish+1
            mib =. index{Positions
        else.
            finish =. region_end (<start),(<steep_up),<down
            areas =. areas,< 'up';start;finish
            index =. finish+1
            mib =. index{Positions
            candidates =. 0 2$0
            for_area. down_areas do.
                'first down_end high' =. area
                last =. finish
                if. -.high xle (last+1){Positions do.
                    continue.
                end.
                top =. first{Positions
                if. ((last+1){Positions)xle top do.
                    while. (first<down_end)*.((first+1){Positions)>(last+1){Positions do.
                        first =. first+1
                    end.
                elseif. top xle (last+1){Positions do.
                    while. (last>start)*.((last-1){Positions)>top do.
                        last =. last-1
                    end.
                end.
                if. ((1+last-first)>:XiMinSize)*.(first<:down_end)*.last>:start do.
                    candidates =. candidates,first,last
                end.
            end.
            clusters =. clusters,|.candidates
        end.
    end.
    labels =. N$_1
    cluster_labels =. (#clusters)$_1
    parents =. (#clusters)$_1
    walls =. 0 3$0
    next_label =. 0
    for_number. i.#clusters do.
        'first last' =. number{clusters
        positions =. first+i.1+last-first
        if. *./_1=positions{labels do.
            labels =. next_label positions}labels
            cluster_labels =. next_label number}cluster_labels
            next_label =. next_label+1
        end.
        valley =. <./(first+1+i.last-first){Positions
        walls =. walls,(first{Positions),((last+1){Positions),valley
        best =. _1
        best_size =. 0
        for_other. i.#clusters do.
            'a b' =. other{clusters
            size =. 1+b-a
            own_size =. 1+last-first
            if. (other~:number)*.(a<:first)*.(b>:last)*.((size>own_size)+.(size=own_size)*.other>number) do.
                if. (best<0)+.size<best_size do.
                    best =. other
                    best_size =. size
                end.
            end.
        end.
        parents =. best number}parents
    end.
    (<areas),(<clusters),(<labels),(<cluster_labels),(<parents),<walls
)

        'labels core' =. extract radius
        clusters =. 1+>./labels

        for_label. i.clusters do.
            sizes =. sizes,+/labels=label
        end.
        counts =. counts,clusters
        largest =. 0

            largest =. >./sizes

    first =. 0

optics_ordering =: 3 : 0
    'points neighborhoods core' =. y
    count =. #points
    reach =. count$INF
    predecessor =. count$_1
    processed =. count$0
    ordering =. i.0
    for_start. i.count do.
        if. start{processed do.
            continue.
        end.
        seeds =. start
        while. #seeds do.
            current =. {.seeds /:(seeds{reach),.seeds
            seeds =. seeds-.current
            processed =. 1 current}processed
            ordering =. ordering,current
            if. INF=current{core do.
                continue.
            end.
            for_other. current{::neighborhoods do.
                if. other{processed do.
                    continue.
                end.
                candidate =. (current{core)>.(current{points)squared_distance other{points
                if. candidate<other{reach do.
                    reach =. candidate other}reach
                    predecessor =. current other}predecessor
                    seeds =. ~.seeds,other
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<ordering),(<reach),<predecessor
)
